thread:
maria: Heads-up — I spotted a cluster of customer reports where reconnects during streaming + tool-call timeouts appear to be double-billed. Console shows provisional > confirmed for the same logical request.
jonathan: Is this the case where router backoff creates a new attempt_id and the ledger treats it as a separate charge? any traces?
maria: Yeah. Flow is: client sends stream, tool call invoked, client times out and reconnects within a few seconds. Router creates a new attempt_id, replays pending toolcall, and billing marks tokens on both attempts.
kevin: Can you paste a minimal log example (ids + events)? that helps confirm where dedupe fails. We currently only reconcile on final ack.
maria: ````
[INFO] session_id=abc123 attempt_id=attA event=tool_invoke tokens=120
[INFO] session_id=abc123 attempt_id=attA event=stream_chunk seq=12
[WARN] client reconnect after 3s
[INFO] session_id=abc123 attempt_id=attB event=tool_invoke tokens=120
[INFO] ledger provisional_charge request_id=attB tokens=120
[INFO] final_ack for attB; attA never confirmed
````
sarah: ops-bot shows a canary router rollout around that timestamp — could be related to backoff/attempt semantics.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for router v2 completed at 2024-12-02T10:08:52Z
emma: We changed the reconnect/backoff heuristic in v2 (linear backoff, shorter retry window) to reduce tail latency. That may have exposed a case where attempt_id is always regenerated and never linked to the old attempt.
kevin: Current billing dedupe key is attempt_id. If v2 always creates new attempt_ids on reconnect, charging will double-count. We should prefer session_id when present, fallback to attempt_id, and add a short grace_window for dedupe.
jonathan: Note: session_id is client-provided and not always present. Router-side heuristic could be: if reconnect occurs within `grace_window` (e.g., 10s) and KV cache still has prefix, treat as same logical stream. Need telemetry to validate false-positives.
maria: UX: console should surface provisional vs confirmed tokens per request and show 'retry' markers. Customers are confused when they see a big provisional spike.
emma: Telemetry proposal: emit fields `retry_source` (client|router), `attempt_origin_ts`, `resume_offset`, and `dedupe_hint` boolean. Also tag ledger entries with `provisional:true|false`.
kevin: Proposed short-term mitigation: router dedupe by (session_id OR client_ip+client_ts) within 10s and mark replays as `provisional_replay` so they don't finalize billing until ack. Long-term: attempt->session mapping persisted in router to properly mark replays.
sarah: Caveat: we must avoid underbilling legitimate retries (e.g., client retried after server crash and original attempt actually failed). Maybe only discount provisional until final confirmation and provide reconciliation UI.
jonathan: UX compromise: show a "provisional discount" column in the cost breakdown with an ops toggle to auto-reconcile provisional charges after N minutes. Also add an alert when provisional - confirmed delta > 500 tokens for a customer.
maria: I'll open a PR with the sample traces, telemetry schema, and a small console mock for the provisional column. Also will add recommended client lib change to always set `session_id`.
kevin: Filed infra issue INFRA-2345 to track router dedupe prototype and ledger tagging. I'll start a branch and pair with @maria.
emma: :thumbsup:
